name: Shadowplay

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

text:
Requirements Your last action was a melee Strike that damaged your opponent.

---
As your blow lands, you detach from your shadow to get the drop on your enemy. You attempt to tumble-through options=shadowplay the opponent's space, with a +2 circumstance bonus to the Acrobatics check. If you succeed, your shadow rises up from the ground, flanking your opponent until the beginning of your next turn.
